notes: The computer/laptop running MATLAB is not a catalogue part and is not modelled; the USB cable is joined to the UNO only.
Parts list gives 6 jumper wires but the circuit description names only 5 (white, orange, gray, red, green); the sixth is not identifiable, so only 5 wires are modelled.
The text says A0 reads voltage 'from pin13', but also says the white wire brings 5V to the potentiometer; I followed the white=5V description. D13 is only used for the built-in LED.

Exact breadboard holes are assumed since the circuit image was not available; the electrical topology follows the text: 5V->pot VCC, GND->pot GND, pot wiper->A0, pin 11 -> resistor -> LED anode, LED cathode -> GND.
Resistor value not given; 220 ohm assumed. LED anode (long leg) goes to the resistor, cathode to GND.
